thag1.27:1.1: The grasses mentioned are _dabba_, _kusa_, _poṭakila_ (kans grass, wild sugarcane), _usīra_ (vetiver), _muñja_ (sugarcane bamboo grass), and _pabbaja_ (here unlikely to be *Eleusine indica* per usual identification, because it is too short. Perhaps meadow foxtail (*Alopecurus pratensis*). [thag3.5]() gives a little more context.
